name: vigent-whatsapp-bridge
description: WhatsApp Web (Baileys) bridge for the vigent platform. Holds long-lived QR-login sessions and forwards inbound messages to the Next.js app.

scripts.dev: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun --hot index.ts; else npx tsx watch index.ts; fi
scripts.start: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun index.ts; else npx tsx index.ts; fi
